pli-tv-bi-vb-np5:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np5:1.2: tena kho pana samayena Thullanandā bhikkhunī gilānā hoti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np5:1.3: atha kho aññataro upāsako yena Thullanandā bhikkhunī ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā Thullanandaṃ bhikkhuniṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-bi-vb-np5:1.4: kacci ayye khamanīyaṃ kacci yāpanīyan ti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np5:1.5: na me āvuso khamanīyaṃ na yāpanīyan ti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np5:1.6: amukassa ayye āpaṇikassa ghare kahāpaṇaṃ nikkhipissāmi, tato yaṃ iccheyyāsi taṃ āharāpeyyāsīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np5:1.8: gaccha sikkhamāne amukassa āpaṇikassa gharā kahāpaṇassa telaṃ āharā 'ti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np5:1.9: atha kho sā sikkhamānā tassa āpaṇikassa gharā kahāpaṇassa telaṃ āharitvā Thullanandāya bhikkhuniyā adāsi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np5:1.11: na me sikkhamāne telena attho, sappinā me attho 'ti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np5:1.12: atha kho sā sikkhamānā yena so āpaṇiko ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā taṃ āpaṇikaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-bi-vb-np5:1.13: na kira āvuso ayyāya telena attho, sappinā attho. handa te telaṃ, sappiṃ me dehīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np5:1.14: sace mayaṃ ayye vikkītaṃ bhaṇḍaṃ puna ādiyissāma . . .
pli-tv-bi-vb-np5:1.15: telassa kayena telaṃ haṭaṃ, sappissa kayaṃ āhara, sappiṃ harissasīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np5:1.16: atha kho sā sikkhamānā rodantī aṭṭhāsi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np5:1.19: atha kho sā sikkhamānā bhikkhunīnaṃ etam atthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np5:1.21: kathaṃ hi nāma ayyā Thullanandā aññaṃ cetāpetvā aññaṃ cetāpessatīti --pa--.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np5:1.22: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave . . . (see IV.1. Instead of viññāpetvā etc. read cetāpetvā) . . .
pli-tv-bi-vb-np5:1.28.1: yā pana bhikkhunī aññaṃ cetāpetvā aññaṃ cetāpeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyan ti. ||1||
